result.rationale: The diff shows the height postMessage is only sent inside window.onload in app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb, while embed.js listens for 'discourse-resize' messages to resize the iframe. Since content like avatars/images may finish loading after onload (changing document height) and best.html.erb's content height may grow after the initial paint, the iframe height sent once could be stale, clipping content. The mechanism described is verifiable in the diff; whether it manifests as a real defect depends on runtime image loading, so confidence is moderate.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb`, the embedded page posts its height to the parent in `window.onload`. `onload` fires after the document and its dependent resources (including images like avatars/logo) have finished loading, so the computed `document['body'].offsetHeight` should reflect the fully loaded static server-rendered content (`embed/best.html.erb`). The diff does not introduce any client-side dynamic content changes inside the iframe after load that would require repeated resize messages. Therefore, claiming it “never updates as content loads” is not a verifiable defect from this diff; it’s speculative about future/dynamic resizing behavior not shown here.
